spans.s:
जु जु, see 1. जू. The form of this root
given in the Dhātu-pāṭha is जु, but the deri-
vatives from it have the vowel long.

जू 1. जू (or according to the Dhātu-pāṭha
जु), cl. 1. P. A., 9. P. जवति, -ते, जुनाति, &c.,
to press forwards, hurry on, move on quickly, be
quick; to impel quickly, urge or drive on, incite; to
excite, promote, animate, inspire.

2. जू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ, Ved. quick, speedy; (according
to Sāy. जूः may also be the Nom. c. of जुर्, old); in-
citing, pressing, driving; (ऊस्), f. speed, expedition,
velocity, going, motion; the atmosphere; a female
demon or goblin; an epithet of the goddess Sarasvatī;
a spot or mark on the forehead of horses and oxen;
[cf. कशो-जू and मनो-जू.]
